pages.text: Your first night was a dream, and we were the cats in it. When you woke, you chose your own path:
pages.title: Your First Steps

pages.text: $(li)As a $(l)kittypet$() in a Twoleg garden at the edge of ThunderClan's woods, until a patrol found you.$(li)As an $(l)apprentice$() in the Clan of your choosing.$(li)As a $(l)loner$() by the lake, free to visit any camp and ask to join, or to stay free.
Whichever path you chose, the Clans will notice you. Be brave, be kind, and keep the warrior code in your heart.
